heroEyebrow: Moving from Systems of Record to a System of Intelligence
heroTitle: A semantic layer for corporate real estate strategy.
heroBody: We deploy a Common Data Model and CRE ontology that makes portfolio decisions computable: neutral across vendors, aligned to how your business actually runs, and structured for deterministic analytics and enterprise AI.

heroCards.title: Neutral by design
heroCards.body: Agnostic to your service providers and software. We normalize data across HR, Finance, and CRE systems so strategy stays in your control.

heroCards.title: 10x faster data engineering
heroCards.body: We automate the data engineering work so you get value in months, not multi-year internal data lake cycles.

heroCards.title: Deterministic AI foundation
heroCards.body: We structure data for precision. AI that calculates with governance and repeatability, rather than guessing with probability.

issueTitle: The issue is not reporting. It is architecture.
issueBody: Most CRE stacks were built to capture reality (payments, work orders, lease abstracts). They are great at looking backward. They struggle to forecast and connect decisions to P&L, employee experience, ESG goals, and risk. That gap turns teams into manual data janitors.

issueCards.title: The 80/20 trap
issueCards.body: Teams spend most of their time aggregating disconnected data and too little time making decisions.

issueCards.title: The vendor bias
issueCards.body: Service-provider data models optimize delivery for the vendor, not the occupier's strategy.

issueCards.title: The IT bottleneck
issueCards.body: Generalist data projects take years because the CRE semantics and grain are missing.
